notes: §1985:VI.6.24.4 GR4: 'the execution of the run unit is suspended and literal-1 is communicated to the operator', continuing with the next executable statement under the implementor-defined reinitiation procedure (§1985:C.2 item 41; §1985:C.1: 'substantially defined by the implementor'). VisitStopStatement admits STOP literal at --std 85 (COBOL0902 from 2002); BindStop binds BoundStopLiteral, now decoding a figurative constant to its one-character value (kb/Work PB5074, closing the prior DIVERGES) after ScreenStopLiteral applies SR1/SR3 (COBOL6817); StatementEmitter.Visit(BoundStopLiteral) writes it to standard error and continues, the procedure docs/VERSION_CHANGE_REFERENCE.md row 7.11 and docs/conformance/3/D-SEQ.md record. Probed at 85: "PAUSE-1", ZERO (0), SPACE, QUOTE, 12, HIGH-VALUE/LOW-VALUE (same bytes as DISPLAY) reach stderr and execution continues in a sentence, an IF and a performed paragraph; ALL "A", 1.5, -1, "" and WITH ERROR STATUS refused. Reading: no operator wait (GnuCOBOL waits for input), within the implementor's latitude. The witness displays lines before and after STOP "PAUSE". History: until the 1985 re-read 5 (2026-11-14) this row read DIVERGES, naming kb/Work PB5074 (landed); the re-read of main dc1f2dcce8 found that defect fixed by the landing of kb/Work PB5074 and records CONFORMS, upheld by an independent refuter (code read: op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-08.json, refuter op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-08-refute.json).

next.reason: 1985: "If STOP literal-1 is specified, the execution of the run unit is suspended and literal-1 is communicated to the operator."; 2023: "Format is only STOP RUN [WITH ERROR/NORMAL STATUS literal-1]; "Execution of the run unit terminates"". The 2023 STOP format offers only STOP RUN. The suspend-and-resume STOP literal-1 is gone. A literal in WITH STATUS is passed to the OS at termination, not shown to an operator awaiting resumption.
